title: webapi.call
description: Call an exact approved WebAPI as the profile grant owner. JSON returns the DSM envelope; raw (since 0.12.1) requires profile raw_max_bytes and returns content_type, size, sha256 and base64 body or private staging handle. Never retried.

response_type.description: Defaults to json. Raw requires an explicitly approved raw_max_bytes profile.

expected_size.description: Raw only: exact byte size of the pinned source version from metadata. Narrows staging reservation and execution budget; mismatch is refused.

params.description: JSON API arguments, at most 32768 encoded bytes; authentication, runner and dispatch keys are forbidden.
